artDirection: Square premium editorial photography; grounded Atlantic atmosphere; textured stone and oak; slate blue, weathered teal and warm amber practical lighting; realistic optics and natural side light; central subject safe for square and 4:3 crops; no text, logos, globes or holographic overlays.

images.prompt: A contemporary coastal research workspace overlooking a working Atlantic container port. Foreground an oak worktable with paper charts and an understated brass compass; distant cranes and infrastructure. Wide but composed, a sense of informed independent perspective.

Supplied by the owner, not generated here: an isometric walled stone enclosure on a slate slab, a lit stepped plinth at its centre, an amber path leading in through one gate and teal circuit lines running out. Departs from the photographic art direction above; the illustration reads as a diagram of one question brought inside a defined boundary, which is what the page says the Briefing is for.
images.source: Images/C1_lifted_panel.png (1600x1600, opaque apart from its four rounded corners — a dark panel rather than a cutout, so it takes the same framed treatment as the other four at 1200x1200. Third candidate and the one kept: B_isolated_cutout.png and A_softened_panel.png preceded it on 2026-09-09. Note for the next replacement: an alpha channel does not make a file a cutout — count the non-opaque pixels. A genuine cutout would need the frame and scrim dropped, because the caption scrim is fixed dark and floats a dark band over transparency on the light theme.)

images.prompt: An elegant technical inspection bench: a silicon circuit board under a large optical inspection lens, finely connected dark teal circuit traces and a few amber status lights, adjacent neatly stacked evidence papers with no readable text. Concrete material detail, precision, tracing dependencies, not science fiction.

A modern coastal watchpoint on an Atlantic headland, a substantial stone observation room and a wide window looking onto shipping lanes and a distant working port, a warm desk light glowing inside. Calm continued observation of a changing horizon; no globe, no telescope, no people.

A considered overhead editorial still life on an oak strategy table, physical architectural blocks and three different branching routes marked on translucent tracing sheets, a single brass ruler, dark teal and stone grey materials. Suggest a consequential choice grounded in evidence, no chess pieces, no readable text.
